item.title: Meghan Markle's Dad Ruled Competent, Scientist Wins Case, and Clavicular Charged, with Geragos, Merchant, and Frei | Ep. 1446 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Mark Geragos, co-host of In The Well, Ashleigh Merchant, co-host of The MK True Crime Show, and Viva Frei, Rumble creator and former litigator, to discuss exactly how Russell Brand was railroaded by the UK legal system, the effort by politicians to censor and silence him, Meghan Markle’s father Thomas ruled competent to stand trial, why he still may not make it to trial on the alarming CSAM charges against him, why prosecutors are attempting to try the 15-year-old son of Kim Zolciak and Kroy Biermann as an adult, the inside story about the disturbing charges he previously faced in juvenile court, how one top MIT scientist won his defamation case against his female colleague who he had a relationship with, the way she tried to spin the consensual relationship into a "MeToo" type situation, the shocking deposition video and text messages released showing what was really going on, the looksmaxxing influencer Clavicular being charged with r*pe, additional context about the accuser and text messages, and more.
